Parent's oracle circularity gap (audit V1, EXP-RUNTIME-35542474231) is resolved: the deployable decoder works without SHA256 oracle on DYNAMIC responses.

Brotli (magic 0xCEB2CF81) and gzip (magic 0x1F8B) have distinct format signatures making greedy try-brotli-then-gzip order unambiguous at every layer: zero ambiguous tie-breaks across 693 observations (EXP-RUNTIME-35544804817).
Encoding-agnostic method distribution (br=60, gz+br=60, gz=80, gz+gz=40) matches parent oracle-guided exactly, confirming deterministic decompression paths per cell.
CDN does not corrupt bytes: the parent fixed-origin-order failure was in the framing assumption, not byte transformation (EXP-RUNTIME-35538865067 + EXP-RUNTIME-35542474231).

Localhost iterative decompression correctness: 840/840 (brotli+gzip single-layer + multi-layer), 480/480 streaming TE framing, 840/840 streaming decompressor API (EXP-RUNTIME-35522287921, EXP-RUNTIME-35530588298, EXP-RUNTIME-35549699298).
Iterative decompression (max_depth=5) handles multi-layer stacked encodings (gzip->brotli, brotli->gzip) correctly on localhost (EXP-RUNTIME-35541777099).

recommended_action: Design and execute EXP-RUNTIME on a production Cloudflare zone or alternative CDN (Fastly/Akamai/CloudFront) that produces cache HIT responses. The frozen design should: (1) use the same oracle-free greedy decode algorithm; (2) include N=5 per HIT cell with two-phase populate+test; (3) persist all raw observations including stability rows; (4) re-run oracle-guided and fixed-order baselines on same wire bytes; (5) deduplicate depth/large observations; (6) record CDN edge. If HIT serving is achieved and >=90% correct, C-MEAS-VALID can advance to VALIDATED. If HIT serving reveals stale-cache divergence, the specific failure mode will be documented. If no CDN produces HITs, the HIT sub-question should be explicitly marked infra-blocked and the DYNAMIC-only finding promoted with ceiling annotation.
